defect_found.title: Parking a run made two projection consumers invent a canonical position
defect_found.discovered_by: this canary — the first genuine package run
defect_found.symptom: After parking, package-run-state reported current_gate "repurposing" (the LAST of 14 gates) with zero complete gates, for a run that never passed gate two. It read as "nearly finished".
defect_found.root_cause: Parking correctly marks every gate `inactive` (readiness markers become diagnostics only for an inactive run). But both current-gate resolvers fell through to gates[gates.length-1] when no gate matched their expected statuses. workflow-stage-projection.currentCanonicalGate returned the FIRST incomplete gate; package-run-state-projection.currentGateIdFromMap returned the LAST gate. Two consumers, two different invented answers.
defect_found.why_it_mattered: A parked early run displaying the final gate is exactly the class of misleading lifecycle claim this architecture work has been removing. It also re-opened a disagreement between two projection consumers.
defect_found.fix: Both resolvers now detect the all-inactive case explicitly and report no gate (null / "") rather than falling back to a position.
defect_found.active_runs_unaffected: verified — an active run still reports `research` from both resolvers
